title: talamancalia fosbergii
intro: Talamancalia fosbergii, commonly known as the "Talamancalia" or "Fosberg's Talamancalia", is a plant species in the Asteraceae family, native to Costa Rica. This plant is valued for its traditional use in Costa Rican folk medicine, where it is used to treat various health conditions due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Talamancalia fosbergii are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, fight off infections, and promote wound healing. Research has identified the bioactive constituents of Talamancalia fosbergii to be sesquiterpene lactones, including guaianolides and eudesmanolides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
